# The Simple Data Analysis (Core) Library

> Lightweight DuckDB-powered TypeScript library for tabular, SQL, CSV, Parquet, and geospatial data analysis on Deno, Node.js, and Bun.

Install with Deno: `deno add jsr:@nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core`

Install with Node.js: `npm i @nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core`

Install with Bun: `bun add @nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core`

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/main/README.md): Installation, quick start, concepts, and examples.
- [Complete API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/main/llm.md): Generated documentation for public classes, methods, parameters, and examples.
- [JSR API reference](https://jsr.io/@nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core/doc): Searchable documentation for the published package.

## Optional

- [Source repository](https://github.com/nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core): Source code, issues, releases, and contribution guidance.
